thread:
Mia: Ping — PR #4321 ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321

Mia: Quick summary: move audit logs to structured JSON, add X-Audit-Version header, and a tiny IAM tweak so the service account can read the audit bucket. Need 2 approvals (security + infra). Targeting next Wed release — can someone take a look?

Devin: on it, will do a quick pass today. any test vectors?

Mia: tests are in the PR under tests/audit/*. Added migration script: tools/migrate_audit_v1_to_v2.py with example payloads.

Sara: I can review for security. pinging infra for the IAM change: @Jordan?

Jordan: Jordan: looking now. IAM tweak looks small, i'll run terraform plan and post results.

Devin: left a tiny nit about timestamp format — prefer RFC3339 with millis. suggested snippet: `ts = datetime.utcnow().isoformat(timespec='milliseconds') + 'Z'`

Mia: thanks — updated migration script and pushed a commit (sha: 1799001255). updated tests accordingly.

deploy-bot: terraform plan queued for workspace prod-infra by Jordan.

Jordan: plan finished, no diffs affecting prod resources. approving.

Sara: Security LGTM assuming the RFC3339 change is in. approving :+1:.

Mia: awesome — will merge once CI finishes (ETA ~10m). @ops-oncall FYI, this will roll the audit format forward (backwards-compatible via migration).

alert-bot: Notified oncall rotation @ops-oncall.

Mia: merged at 1799001349, changelog entry added and runbook note (docs/runbooks/audit-format.md) updated.

Devin: nice — can we add a short parser fallback note in the runbook (in case older logs slip through)?

Mia: done, added a fallback section and a link to the parser snippet in the runbook. thanks everyone :tada:
